scope: M5 Max native full-GI candidate incremental render cost, not M3 or whole-F14 certification
presentation: default windowed visible drawable, native post; no offscreen substitution, DRS, auto-exposure, EDR or temporal upscaler
archive: default pipeline archive policy retained; record pipeline/fallback/compile metadata
operating_conditions: one GPU process; keep display/window visible; quiet machine with no other agents building/rendering/profiling; stage after final Release build/native gate; no source/artifact changes during the18 runs
excluded: no checkers, debug flags, captures, reference export, GPU capture, Tracy or Metal validation
analysis: For each ABA, baseline=(A1+A2)/2 per reported statistic; delta=B-baseline. Preserve all triples. Across3replicates report each delta, median/min/max and sampleSD. Do not pool quantiles or sum pass medians.
pass_coverage: preserve each pass frames count and timing; steady attribution requires at least90% of512 samples per unit; incomplete coverage does not invalidate the full-frame distribution but blocks per-pass steady claims
memory: report logical engine resource bytes, device allocated bytes, process footprint and paired deltas separately; O7 requires exactly0 measured GPU allocations in everyrun
adoption: no numerical frame-time or memory budget was supplied; report costs and O7/measurement validity, do not invent an adoption threshold. A default change awaits owner's budget decision plus outstanding quality scope.
failure_policy: nonzero exit/error/GPUfailure/O7allocation/config or artifact mismatch invalidates run; drift invalidates timing inference for its triple. Preserve failures; no automatic retries, outlier rejection or picking fastest runs
